events.comment: Achievements extension example. Every achievement is defined once, when the game starts. Progress is saved on this device, so it is still here when you play again (press R to reset).
Optional: an icon for each achievement (shown in the toast), and a secret one.
Unlock an achievement in one go, or add progress: it unlocks when the progress reaches the goal.
Set the progress from any number: here the time spent in the scene, and how many are unlocked.
"Any achievement was just unlocked" is true for one frame: play a sound or give a reward here.
Build the list with a Repeat event: IdAt(i) gives the identifier of each achievement.
The toast works with no setup. These actions change its look and sound.

eventsFunctionsExtensions.author: Luqman Hakeem
eventsFunctionsExtensions.name: Achievements
eventsFunctionsExtensions.shortDescription: Define achievements, unlock them or track their progress, save them on the device, and show a toast when one is unlocked.
description: Add achievements to your game, with no setup.
- Define each achievement once, at the start of the first scene: an identifier, a title, a description and a goal.
- Unlock it in one go, or add progress ("collect 10 coins") and it unlocks when the goal is reached.
- Progress is saved on the player's device automatically.
- Secret achievements hide their title and description until they are unlocked.
- A toast slides in when an achievement is unlocked, with the achievement's own icon and a sound if you want. Change its position, colors, duration and label (to translate it).
- Expressions give the title, description, progress and goal of each achievement, so you can build your own achievements screen.
Achievements are local to the device: they are not linked to Steam, Game Jolt or another platform.

eventsFunctions.description: Define an achievement: its title, description and goal. Do this at the start of the first scene, before unlocking anything. Use a goal of 1 for an achievement that unlocks in one go, or a bigger goal (like 10) for one that unlocks when its progress reaches it. Progress is saved on the player's device.
